{{Quote|Oh, we're having a sleepover, mom. The woklings were just crying&hellip;for more of your sunberry pie!|Wicket Warrick, to his mother|<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" />}}
'''Sunberry pie''' was a [[Pie/Legends|pie]] made of [[Sunberry/Legends|sunberries]] that the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shodu Warrick]] was known to make at a high quality. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], she made some sunberry pie for a [[Bright Tree Fête|festival]] in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. After the festival was over, Shodu's [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]], pretended a group of [[Wokling/Legends|woklings]] was crying due to their wish for more [[Berry/Legends|sunberry]] pie&mdash;in reality, they were frightened after visiting [[Horville's Hut of Horrors]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Here are your sunberries, mom.''"<br />"''Thanks, honey drop. I can always use more berries at carnival time.|Wicket and Shodu Warrick|<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" />}}
Sunberry pie was a type of [[Pie/Legends|pie]] made from [[Sunberry/Legends|sunberries]]. It was [[Color/Legends|beige]] in color, circular, and [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" />

==History==
{{Quote|Your pies always take first prize, Shodu!|Kneesaa, to Shodu Warrick|<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" />}}
[[File:SliceofPie.png|thumb|right|250px|Wicket shoves a slice of pie in the face of Malani.]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{EwoksDate|the appearance of [[Sunberry/Legends|sunberry]] [[Pie/Legends|pie]]|[[Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)|Horville's Hut of Horrors]]}}</ref> at an Ewok [[Bright Tree Fête|festival]] in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], the young Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] delivered a basket of [[Berry/Legends|sunberry]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] to Warrick's [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Shodu Warrick]]. Shodu used the berries to make sunberry pie for the festival and thanked the young Ewoks, saying that she could always use more berries at carnival time. Kintaka praised her pies and noted that they always received first prize. Shodu then asked Wicket and Kintaka to watch over Wicket's [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]] [[Gender/Legends|sister]], [[Winda Warrick|Winda]], while she was busy preparing her pies.<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" />

Later that [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Wicket and Winda returned home with several of Wicket's friends and other woklings after visiting the [[Horville's Hut of Horrors]] attraction, which had scared all of the woklings. As they cried from the fright, the adult Ewoks arrived, and Shodu inquired what was going on. As he was not supposed to have taken them to the Hut of Horrors, Wicket tried to hide the woklings' true reason for crying, claiming that they were having a [[Sleep/Legends|sleepover]] and that the woklings were simply crying for more of Shodu's sunberry pie. As though to prove his point, he and his friends shoved slices of pie into the [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]] of the four woklings who were crying: [[Nippet/Legends|Nippet]], [[Wiley (Ewok)|Wiley]], Winda, and [[Malani]]. Two of the adult Ewoks, [[Weechee Warrick|Weechee]] and [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]], also tried to take slices of the pie, though Shodu took away the pie before the latter could eat any.<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sunberry pie appeared in "[[Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)|Horville's Hut of Horrors]],"<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" /> the sixteenth episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], which was written by [[Paul Dini]] and premiered on [[November 15]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
